cross_record_note.relationship: Both inquire about an NCO named Richter at Aleppo; the later message supplies first name Kurt and more address detail. They are related queries, not identical plaintexts.
cross_record_note.postal_number_constraint: p203 postal cells VA,VA,VV cannot simply be assigned the p210 reading227:2 already occupiesDV in the unchanged Nov16-18 square. No same-address or no-copying-error assumption is made.
